periods.time: One month before public succession, at night

name.zh: 夜架王后身份的两场对决

periods.summary: Lux confronts Yatoro after learning she has secretly guarded him from the shadows. Yatoro refuses to become queen because she wants to remain a hidden weapon, so Lux duels her to prove he can protect himself and that she can live openly as a person.
periods.cause: Yatoro believes becoming queen would prevent her from fulfilling the shadow-guard role needed to keep Lux alive.
periods.process: Lux and Yatoro fight with Bahamut and Yatogami; Lux wins the Drag-Ride duel by cutting through her control-contact setup, but Yatoro wins the second unarmed surprise encounter. Lux vows to challenge her again.
periods.outcome: A one-win-one-loss draw delays her acceptance, but Lux later wins both conditions and she becomes queen by the epilogue.
periods.aftermath: Yatoro keeps testing Lux with surprise attacks even after accepting the queen role.
periods.significance: Resolves Yatoro's tool-versus-human conflict and gives Lux a postwar self-strengthening goal.
